title: TOL/TNW sits exactly on its plausible-band ceiling without breaching it
note: tol_tnw = total_liabilities / tangible_net_worth = 240 / 40 = 6.00x. The plausible band ceiling is 6; compute_ratio's band check is a strict greater-than, so a value exactly at 6.00 does not breach the band (band_breached is false, not true).
